correctness.rationale: Direct two-round Ehrenfeucht--Fraïssé semantics gives equality of sets of pointed atomic-pair diagrams. For a loopless oriented \(n\)-cycle (\(n\geq 3\)) these diagrams are exactly the predecessor/vertex/successor colour triple and the presence mask of colours on all other vertices. Capping global symbol counts at four is exact after excluding three positions. First two and last two letters plus capped counts and triple-factor support define an exact deterministic append transition; all four length-two seed states close to 758 reachable states. Exhaustive traversal thus covers every length, with 48 closed-cycle signatures, shortest representative distribution 4,6,6,9,10,9,4, and four length-nine witnesses. Both supplied Python programs were replayed from the actual final file paths; outputs matched checked records byte-for-byte. A second program directly evaluates all two-round atomic-pair profiles of binary cyclic words through length 15 and constructs an independently closed 758-state summary set. This is an exhaustive finite-state certificate, not a mere finite experiment.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Brown--Hoshino explicitly assumes uncoloured undirected edges, so their q-round cycle threshold neither names the predecessor and successor colours nor determines the requisite 48 realized profile sets. Neither fully read published comparison supplies a theorem whose consequences force the stated exact numeric classification or the optimal nine-cycle representative cutoff.

originality.rationale: Actual searches for two-round Ehrenfeucht--Fraïssé equivalence of binary coloured directed cycles and exact numbers of rank-two theories did not identify this 48-type / sharp-length-nine result. Detailed primary comparisons with Brown--Hoshino (2007) and Weis--Immerman (2007 report / 2009 journal) establish that their theorem statements concern, respectively, uncoloured undirected paths/cycles and two-variable logic on finite linearly ordered words. Two published comparisons were read in full at their scientific RESULT text: one covers uncoloured directed paths and the other one-red linearly ordered words. None of those statements implies the enumeration for two-coloured *cyclic* directed-successor structures, since the cyclic wraparound, two unary colours, and absence of linear order change the isomorphism class and atomic pair diagrams. A missing older specialist enumeration remains a material priority risk; absence of hits alone was not used as proof of originality.
residual_risks: The literature and indexed-record searches are not exhaustive: an unindexed specialised two-colour cyclic-word EF-game classification or a tabulation derivable from a general theorem might anticipate this exact spectrum.
The published bracelet result was compared at abstract/summary level only and was not relied upon to assert full-document noncoverage.

value.rationale: Exact rank-bounded observational quotients and minimal representatives are natural finite-model-theoretic invariants. On oriented cycles with two named colours, the theorem completely classifies the first nontrivial quantifier-depth spectrum (48 classes) and establishes that nine vertices suffice sharply for representing all rank-two theories, replacing unbounded realizations with a complete finite test basis. The 758-state realizability proof is nontrivial, not simply a restatement of the two-round game or arbitrary slice, and provides an explicit reusable classification signature.
